<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- A literal &#00000000065; inside a comment is not parsed as character data. -->
<?platform protected="&#00000000065;"?>
<plist version="1.0" neutral="&#00000000065;">
  <dict>
    <!-- Eight-digit decimal and hexadecimal references remain valid native spellings. -->
    <key>harbor&#00000046;route&#x00000026;east</key>
    <string neutral="&#00000000065;">Guide %1$@ toward &#00000065;, &#x00000042;, 🧭 & <north> "calm" 'steady'</string>

    <!-- CDATA and escaped ampersands retain reference-looking literal source text. -->
    <key>literal&#000000065;</key>
    <string><![CDATA[Literal &#00000000065; remains protected]]></string>

    <key>line&#00000046;break</key>
    <string>North&#00000010;South&#x00000009;EastWest</string>

    <key>escaped.literal</key>
    <string>A&#00000000065;Z</string>
  </dict>
</plist>
